def policy(pieces, to_play, legal_moves, memory):
    import re, random
    piece_values = {'P':1, 'N':3, 'B':3, 'R':5, 'Q':9, 'K':0}
    best_move = None
    best_score = -1e9
    for move in legal_moves:
        score = 0.0
        # capture
        if 'x' in move:
            # get destination square
            m = re.search(r'([a-h][1-8])', move)
            if m:
                dest = m.group(1)
                if dest in pieces:
                    captured_piece = pieces[dest]
                    score += piece_values.get(captured_piece[1],0)
        # promotion
        if '=' in move:
            # piece after =
            promo = move.split('=')[1][0]
            score += piece_values.get(promo,0) - piece_values['P']
        # check or mate
        if '+' in move:
            score += 0.5
        if '#' in move:
            score += 1000
        # castling
        if move in ('O-O','O-O-O'):
            score += 0.2
        # prioritize moves that develop towards center? simple: if move moves a piece to central squares (d4,e4,d5,e5) add 0.1
        central = {'d4','e4','d5','e5','c3','f3','c6','f6'}
        m = re.search(r'([a-h][1-8])', move)
        if m and m.group(1) in central:
            score += 0.1
        # small random to break ties
        score += random.random()*0.01
        if score > best_score:
            best_score = score
            best_move = move
    if best_move is None:
        best_move = legal_moves[0]
    return best_move, memory
